Thói quen của mọi người khi đi chùa là k.en: Everyone's custom in the temple is to ask Buddha for fortune, peace, fortune. However, from the Buddhist point of view, Buddha will grant his wish for a peaceful life, towards good fortunes, not fame. So even if you are going to church, praying at home should be a prayer of peace, health, words from the heart. Excellence, fame is only in accordance with the temples of the gods.
Thói quen của mọi người khi đi chùa là k.zh: 寺中一切众生风俗皆是求佛求福,安乐,福乐. 然而,从佛教的角度来看,佛陀会给予他和平生活的愿望,走向善财,而不是名利. 所以即使你要去教堂,在家里祈祷, 应该是和平,健康,心底话语的祈祷. 卓越,名气只符合神庙.

Toàn gia được an lạc, mọi việc được hanh.en: The family is safe, everything is well.

The Buddha here is self-importance, France represents truth and the increase is an expression of purity. When you wrap your hand in front of your chest or across your forehead, wrap your hand around it like a lotion doll in front of your chest and tie it three times, without leaving your hand too low.
Trong các buổi thờ cúng, sử dụng văn khấ.zh: 在服务中,在家里用和平的祈祷,你只应该为佛陀,法国,和兴修三次,称为谭所讲. 此处的菩萨是自我重要的,法国代表真理,增益是纯洁的表现. 当将手包在胸前或前额上时,将手像乳液娃娃一样包裹在胸前,并捆绑三次,不要把手太低.
